name: contextual-actions-settings-authority
description: Verify player-facing Train, StopTraining, contextual Use, and Settings remotes reach authoritative validation and normalize unsafe payloads.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=assert(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1])
local world=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'))
local storage=game:GetService('ServerStorage')
assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio() and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false and storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'fixture requires ephemeral Studio without live data opt-in')
assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture profile is not ephemeral and ready')
local c=storage.PunchWallAutomation
assert(c:Invoke('Reset').ok==true,'reset failed')
local maximumDistance=38 -- Current authoritative MOBILE_ACTION_DISTANCE; checked against production source offline.
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local interactions=assert(world:FindFirstChild('Interactables'))
local targets={}
for _,def in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do table.insert(targets,(assert(interactions:FindFirstChild(def.name..' Stand'),'configured fist stand missing '..def.name))) end
for _,name in ipairs({'Pet Egg Machine','Rebirth Shrine','Hero Armory Merchant Interaction','Hero Sidekick Scientist Interaction','Honor Keeper Interaction'}) do table.insert(targets,(assert(interactions:FindFirstChild(name),'contextual target missing '..name))) end
local function assertOutsideUseRange(position,parts,range)
 assert(#parts>0 and range>0,'Use target set/range is empty')
 local minimum=math.huge
 for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
  assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Parent,'invalid Use target')
  minimum=math.min(minimum,(position-part.Position).Magnitude)
 end
 assert(minimum>range+2,'fixture is inside an authoritative Use range')
 return minimum
end
-- This grounded point is away from every Use target; Spawn is near a configured Premium stand.
local destination=Vector3.new(0,3,70)
assertOutsideUseRange(destination,targets,maximumDistance)
assert(c:Invoke('Teleport',{position={x=destination.X,y=destination.Y,z=destination.Z}}).ok==true,'out-of-range teleport failed')
local actual=assert(p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')).Position
local minimum=assertOutsideUseRange(actual,targets,maximumDistance)
c:Invoke('ClearCooldowns')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,range=maximumDistance,minimumDistance=minimum,targets=#targets,outsideUseRange=true})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents
g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('CloseMenus')
local response
local connection=events.Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
 if typeof(payload)=='table' and payload.target=='Use' then response={kind=tostring(payload.type or ''),target=tostring(payload.target or '')} end
end)
local ok,err=pcall(function()
 events.ActionRequest:FireServer({action='Use'})
 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 repeat task.wait(.05) until response or os.clock()>=deadline
 assert(response,'no authoritative Use feedback arrived')
 assert(response.kind=='Fail' and response.target=='Use','out-of-range Use was not rejected')
end)
connection:Disconnect()
assert(ok,err)
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,kind=response.kind,target=response.target,actualRemoteFeedback=true})
